question: By what means does the speaker claim to have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to be known or to have become known in this context.
This knowledge comes by the grace of the addressed lord.
The object known is the determination of the Kaula teaching.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The nuance between jñāta as known and made known remains open.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the Kaula determination.
